answer_markdown: For initial fuel fraction estimations, refined aircraft sizing iterations, and total mission fuel calculations, an extra allowance of 6% is typically added to account for reserve and trapped or unusable fuel [2, 3, 6], corresponding to a reserve fuel multiplier of 1.06 [1]. Alternatively, a 5% reserve fuel margin may be added to account for engine degradation or off-nominal conditions [4]. For general-aviation aircraft, FAA rules specifically require carrying reserve fuel sufficient for 30 min of additional cruise flight [5].
